name: [PART 2!🎆] Fight The Monsters: Revamped
desc:
FIXED FIGHT THE MONSTERS (FTM)
GAMEPASSES ARE TRANSFERRED.

In FIGHT THE MONSTERS! Battle dangerous creatures across a vast world. Collect and use 800+ weapons and face massive megabosses that test your strength.

New Content:

~Spire of Fate~
- Added a new tower to the last area in Eden
- Contains 10 floors, each with a boss!
- Contains 6 different drops, including a summoning weapon

~2x Damage~
- 2x Damage is enabled until the Halloween event!

~Other~
- Added another quest to the Zone 2 Master
- Added a final quest to the Catacombs master
- Added 2 new chat tags for the Spire and Catacombs Master

~Improvements~
- Made enemies rarer to spawn in Zone 2
- Generation fixes in Zone 2
- Bugfixes
- Performance Improvements
